name: Corner of Macao Bay, looking west
dimensions: Dimensions taken from <u>Victoria & Albert Museum Department of Prints and Drawings and Department of Paintings, Accessions 1928. </u> London: HMSO, 1929
summary: A view of the smaller houses towards the western end of the Praya Grande, with Fort Bomparto by the bay, from which a wall runs up Penha Hill. In the foreground Chinese figures stand or sit beneath the shade of a rattan shelter.

collection.museum: 维多利亚与艾尔伯特博物馆
